## Summary
Upgrades `@nestjs/common` from 8.4.3 to 10.4.16 to resolve 33 vulnerabilities, including critical prototype pollution (CVE-2026-41907), axios SSRF/proxy bypass issues (CVE-2026-44492, CVE-2025-62718, CVE-2026-101904), and a direct file upload vulnerability (CVE-2024-29409). Upgrades `uuid` to 11.x and `axios` to 1.x via the NestJS update.

Closes #104
/attempt
